entries.claim: agent 必须从仓库根运行，才会自动拾取 AGENTS.md 并遵守其规则

sources.quote: If you use an agent, run it from the `pi` root directory so it picks up `AGENTS.md` automatically. Your agent must follow the rules and guidelines in that file.

entries.claim: 提问先答后改；散文直接、简洁、无套话

sources.quote: - Technical prose only, be direct
- When the user asks a question, answer it first before making edits or running implementation commands.

entries.claim: 改代码后跑 npm run check，全量输出、不允许只截尾；check 不跑测试

sources.quote: - After code changes (not docs): `npm run check` (full output, no tail). Fix all errors, warnings, and infos before committing. Does not run tests.

entries.claim: 未经用户请求不得运行 npm run build 或 npm test

sources.quote: - Never run `npm run build` or `npm test` unless requested by the user.

entries.claim: 不得直接跑全量 vitest（含 e2e）；非 e2e 用 ./test.sh，或从包根跑单文件

sources.quote: - Never run the full vitest suite directly: it includes e2e tests that activate when endpoint/auth env vars are present. For all non-e2e tests, run `./test.sh` from the repo root. Otherwise run specific tests from the package root:

entries.claim: coding-agent test/suite 必须用 test/suite/harness.ts + faux provider，禁止真实 key

sources.quote: - For `packages/coding-agent/test/suite/`, use `test/suite/harness.ts` + the faux provider. No real provider APIs, keys, or paid tokens.

entries.claim: 修 issue 的回归测试旁必须写 issue 号注释

sources.quote: - When regressions tests for fixing a github issue, add a comment with the github issue number next to the test.

entries.claim: 临时脚本写入 /tmp 文件再跑，不内嵌多行脚本

sources.quote: - For ad-hoc scripts, `write` them to a temp file (e.g. `/tmp`), run, edit if needed, remove when done. Don't embed multi-line scripts in `bash` commands.

entries.claim: 直接 registry 依赖（含内部 workspace 包）必须精确版本

sources.quote: - Treat npm dep and lockfile changes as reviewed code. Direct registry deps, including internal workspace deps, stay pinned to exact versions.

entries.claim: 本地用 npm install --ignore-scripts 水合，CI 用 npm ci；不得擅自跑 lifecycle 脚本

sources.quote: - Hydrate/update locally with `npm install --ignore-scripts`; clean/CI-style with `npm ci --ignore-scripts`. Don't run lifecycle scripts unless the user asks.

entries.claim: 带安装脚本的新依赖须评审并进显式 allowlist；lockfile 提交被 pre-commit 拦截

sources.quote: - If `packages/coding-agent/install-lock/` needs regen, run `node scripts/generate-coding-agent-install-lock.mjs` (verify with `--check` or `npm run check`). New deps with lifecycle scripts require review and an explicit allowlist entry in that script; never add one silently.
- Pre-commit blocks lockfile commits unless `PI_ALLOW_LOCKFILE_CHANGE=1`. Don't bypass unless the user wants the lockfile change committed.

entries.claim: 除非用户要求，否则不提交

sources.quote: - Never commit unless the user asks.

entries.claim: 只提交本次自己改的文件；显式暂存路径，禁止 git add -A/.

sources.quote: - Only commit files YOU changed in THIS session.
- Stage explicit paths (`git add <path1> <path2>`); never `git add -A` / `git add .`.

entries.claim: 禁止 reset --hard、checkout .、clean -fd、stash 与 --no-verify；永不 force push

sources.quote: - `git reset --hard`, `git checkout .`, `git clean -fd`, `git stash`, `git add -A`, `git add .`, `git commit --no-verify`.
- Never force push.

entries.claim: commit message 格式固定为 {feat,fix,docs}[(scope)]: <message>

sources.quote: - Message format: `{feat,fix,docs}[(ai,tui,agent,coding-agent)]: <commit message> (optionally multiple lines)`. Message is informative and concise.

entries.claim: pi 的核保持最小；不属于核的功能应做成扩展，膨胀核的 PR 会被拒

sources.quote: First things first: **pi's core is minimal**.
If your feature does not belong in the core, it should be an extension. PRs that bloat the core will likely be rejected.

entries.claim: 提交者必须理解自己的代码；不理解而提交 AI 产物会被关闭

sources.quote: **You must understand your code.** If you cannot explain what your changes do and how they interact with the rest of the system, your PR will be closed.
Using AI to write code is fine. Submitting AI-generated slop without understanding it is not.

entries.claim: 新贡献者的 issue 与 PR 默认自动关闭

sources.quote: All issues and PRs from new contributors are auto-closed by default.

entries.claim: lgtmi/lgtm 解锁贡献资格，命令须在回复开头或结尾；只有 lgtm 允许开 PR

sources.quote: - `lgtmi`: your future issues will not be auto-closed
- `lgtm`: your future issues and PRs will not be auto-closed
The command must be at the start of the reply (optionally after one or more `@username` mentions) or at the end. `lgtmi` does not grant rights to submit PRs. Only `lgtm` grants rights to submit PRs.

entries.claim: 开 PR 前必须已获 lgtm；npm run check 与 ./test.sh 都必须通过

sources.quote: Do not open a PR unless you have already been approved by a maintainer using `lgtm` in the command position described above.
npm run check
Both must pass.

entries.claim: 贡献者不得改 CHANGELOG.md，条目由维护者添加

sources.quote: Do not edit `CHANGELOG.md`. Changelog entries are added by maintainers.

entries.claim: 生成模型数据目录被 gitignore：不得暂存，也不要从 git 历史里找

sources.quote: - Never modify `packages/ai/src/models.generated.ts` directly; update `packages/ai/scripts/generate-models.ts` instead, then regenerate. Including the resulting `models.generated.ts` diff is always OK, even if regeneration includes unrelated upstream model metadata changes. The generated model data in `packages/ai/src/providers/data/` is gitignored: never stage it, and don't look for it in git history.
